tracker.name: Requirement
tracker.description:
Engineering Artifact tracker. Each artifact here is one immutable version node in a git-like graph, not an editable living document: once created, never change its title/description/logical_id/branch again, especially once another artifact has linked back to it as a parent. To evolve a requirement, create a NEW artifact and link it to its parent(s) via the Links field (nature: "Related to" - custom natures deferred pending site-admin access; document the relationship as "derived from" in the description). Multiple parent links on one artifact represent a merge of branches. logical_id stays identical across every version/branch of "the same" requirement, so all its history can be found by searching that value; branch is a free-text label (e.g. main, UEV-branch) naming which line of evolution this node sits on. This tracker also links to Feature artifacts it realizes, and will later be referenced by Design, Test Case and Document artifacts, and pinned into Baseline Item snapshots.
version_label is a human-readable sequence label, filled in manually for now: the starting label of your convention for the first node on a branch, the next one for each following node on the SAME branch whose parent is the previous label, and reset to the starting label whenever a node's branch differs from its parent's (i.e. a fork). This is not enforced automatically - Tuleap has no native per-branch auto-increment. A real automation would need a small script (using the Tuleap REST API, or the Enterprise tracker-functions/post-action plugin) that, on artifact creation, looks up the parent's branch and version_label and computes the next value; this is a candidate for a later phase, not built yet.
IMPORTANT - two distinct kinds of parent/child relate Requirement artifacts to each other, and the single Links field disambiguates them by NATURE, not by any field value: (1) structural breakdown - a static document outline (spec -> chapter -> sub-requirement), unrelated to versioning - uses Tuleap's built-in reserved "Child"/"Parent" link nature, the same trick already used for the Feature Catalog tree, so no site-admin-defined custom nature is needed; (2) version lineage - the git-like evolution graph described above (this version's prior revision(s)) - uses the plain, unnamed "Related to" nature, exactly as documented above. Never mix the two: a structural parent (e.g. a chapter) is not a version parent, and a version parent (an earlier revision of the same logical_id) is not a structural parent. A chapter-level node (e.g. a "Chapter: X Requirements" artifact one level below a spec root) may itself carry a Realizes-Feature link, not only its leaf children, so a report can filter "everything (chapter or leaf) relevant to Feature X" in one pass without inferring a chapter's relevance from its children.

formElement.name: logical_id
formElement.label: Logical ID
formElement.description: Stable identifier shared by every version/branch of "the same" requirement, e.g. REQ-BRK-003. Never changes across versions.

formElement.name: branch
formElement.label: Branch
formElement.description: Free-text label naming which line of evolution this version node sits on, e.g. main, UEV-branch. Not a predefined list, since branches are created ad hoc.

formElement.name: version_label
formElement.label: Version label
formElement.description: Sequence label within this branch, in whatever convention your team uses - plain increments ("1", "2", "3"), a padded pattern ("PN006", "PN007"), or anything else. First node on a branch gets the starting label of that convention; each following node on the SAME branch, whose parent is the previous label, gets the next one; reset to the starting label whenever a node's branch differs from its parent's (i.e. a fork). Filled in manually for now - see tracker description for the planned automation. Note: this is a text field, so it sorts alphabetically in reports, not numerically - zero-pad (v01, v02, ...) if you need correct ordering past single digits.

formElement.name: art_link
formElement.label: Links
formElement.description: Two link natures on this one field, never to be confused: "Related to" for this version's parent(s) (its prior revision, or more than one if merging branches); reserved "Child"/"Parent" for the structural breakdown parent (the chapter or spec this node sits under in the document outline). Also link to the Feature artifact(s) this requirement (or, for a chapter-level node, this whole chapter) realizes.
